title: Prisma DIDs: Decentralized IDs for Verifiable Contributions

ms.promise:
A: DID registration system via WalletConnect
B: Verifiable Credential issuance and verification modules
C: Privacy settings interface with selective disclosure controls
D: Basic user interface for DID management
E: 1 API documentation for all developed modules
ms.criteria:
A1: Successful DID's issuance to at least 15 participants, including onboarding to first use. 
B1: VC issuance and verification working correctly. 
C1: Privacy panel allows selective disclosure. 
D1: User interface allows intuitive DID management for users and organisations. 
E1: API documentation for all developed modules is complete and approved.
ms.report:
A. Output: DID registration system via WalletConnect
Acceptance criteria: Successful DID issuance to at least 15 participants, including onboarding to first use.
Evidence:
・Functional deployment on Cardano testnet showing the DID registration system via WalletConnect:
・https://dids-dashboard-production.up.railway.app (DIDs)
・https://vcs-dashboard-production.up.railway.app/credentials (VCs)
・20 DIDs created, by various collaborators: 
・https://airtable.com/appivPJCmhlz4OZHO/shrCojshEPaI1z4Q9 

B. Output: Verifiable Credential issuance and verification modules
Acceptance criteria: VC issuance and verification working correctly.
Evidence:
・Code repository containing all modules, including the Verifiable Credential issuance and verification modules:
・https://github.com/prisma-collective/Dids

C. Output: Privacy settings interface with selective disclosure controls
Acceptance criteria: Privacy panel allows selective disclosure.
Evidence:
・https://youtu.be/uDSpbrn828o

D. Output: Basic user interface for DID management
Acceptance criteria: User interface allows intuitive DID management for users and organisations.
Evidence:
・https://youtu.be/w86RPFpbwPM

E. Output: API documentation for all developed modules
Acceptance criteria: API documentation for all developed modules is complete and approved.
Evidence:
・Code repository/documentation containing the API documentation for all developed modules:
・https://github.com/prisma-collective/Dids/blob/main/documentation/API.md

ms.promise:
A: Security audit report, with a trusted Third-party.
B: Pilot implementation report & feedback analysis document.
C: Comprehensive test plan and test cases used during the testing phase.
D: Updated documentation reflecting all changes and improvements made during refinement.
E: Publicly accessible prototype (MVP).
ms.criteria:
A1: The Security Audit Report is completed by a trusted third-party and contains no critical vulnerabilities.
B1: The Pilot Implementation Report is complete, and the feedback analysis has been incorporated into the product.
C1: The Comprehensive Test Plan and test cases have been executed with a 100% success rate.
D1: The updated documentation accurately reflects all changes and improvements made during refinement.
E1: The publicly accessible prototype (MVP) is live and meets the technical specifications.
ms.report:
A. Output: Infrastructure and platform architecture security audit
Acceptance criteria: An external review report confirming the security, structural integrity, and absence of critical vulnerabilities in the Prisma DIDs platform implementation and infrastructure.
Evidence: https://github.com/prisma-collective/dids/blob/main/documentation/PRISMA_DIDs_Security_Audit_Report.pdf 
(The audit was conducted by ReFaz, a Brazilian Web3 infrastructure and impact capital studio specializing in navigating technical and regulatory complexities for sophisticated Web3 products).

B. Output: Pilot implementation report & feedback analysis document.
Acceptance criteria: The Pilot Implementation Report is complete, and the feedback analysis has been incorporated into the product.
Evidence: 
・https://github.com/prisma-collective/dids/blob/main/documentation/IMPLEMENTATION_REPORT.md
・https://github.com/prisma-collective/dids/blob/main/documentation/FEEDBACK_ANALYSIS_FROM_IMPLEMENTATION_REPORT.md

C. Output: Comprehensive test plan and test cases used during the testing phase.
Acceptance criteria: The Comprehensive Test Plan and test cases have been executed with a 100% success rate.
Evidence: https://github.com/prisma-collective/dids/blob/main/documentation/TEST_PLAN.md

D. Output: Updated documentation reflecting all changes and improvements made during refinement.
Acceptance criteria: The updated documentation accurately reflects all changes and improvements made during refinement.
Evidence: https://github.com/prisma-collective/dids/tree/main/documentation

E. Output: Publicly accessible prototype (MVP).
Acceptance criteria: The publicly accessible prototype (MVP) is live and meets the technical specifications.
Evidence: 
・DIDs: https://dids-dashboard-production.up.railway.app/
・VCs: https://vcs-dashboard-production.up.railway.app/
